modelEffortNextDescription: Cycle the model's available effort levels and briefly show the selected level.
sidebarAddProjectDescription: Open the Create project dialog to import a local folder.
sidebarSearchDescription: Open the sidebar search palette from anywhere in the app.
sidebarActivityDescription: Show or hide running tasks, completed work, and items that need attention.
sidebarImportThreadDescription: Bring an existing conversation into the current workspace.
spacePreviousDescription: Switch to the previous project space and restore its last working context.
spaceNextDescription: Switch to the next project space and restore its last working context.
spaceJumpVoidDescription: Switch straight to the Void tab of the space switcher.
spaceJumpDescription: Switch straight to this tab of the space switcher.
chatNewDescription: Start a fresh thread in the current project, or the most recent one.
chatNewLatestProjectDescription: Jump back into the most recently used project with a new thread.
chatNewChatDescription: Open the empty chat landing view.
chatNewTerminalDescription: Create a thread that opens directly into terminal mode.
chatNewClaudeDescription: Start a fresh thread with Claude selected.
chatNewCodexDescription: Start a fresh thread with Codex selected.
chatNewCursorDescription: Start a fresh thread with Cursor selected.
chatSplitDescription: Split the focused pane to the right, or open the current conversation in a second pane.
paneSplitDownDescription: Split the focused pane top/bottom and focus the new empty pane.
paneSplitLeftDescription: Split the focused pane and place the new empty pane to its left.
paneSplitRightDescription: Split the focused pane and place the new empty pane to its right.
paneSplitUpDescription: Split the focused pane and place the new empty pane above it.
paneFocusLeftDescription: Move focus to the nearest pane on the left.
paneFocusRightDescription: Move focus to the nearest pane on the right.
paneFocusUpDescription: Move focus to the nearest pane above.
paneFocusDownDescription: Move focus to the nearest pane below.
paneMoveLeftDescription: Move the focused pane's chat into the pane on its left.
paneMoveRightDescription: Move the focused pane's chat into the pane on its right.
paneMoveUpDescription: Move the focused pane's chat into the pane above it.
paneMoveDownDescription: Move the focused pane's chat into the pane below it.
paneMaximizeDescription: Show only the focused pane, or restore the split layout.
paneCloseDescription: Close the focused pane; the remaining panes resize to fill the space.
viewFocusModeToggleDescription: Hide both sidebars and show only the focused pane.
themeCycleDescription: Switch between light, dark, and system appearance.
sidebarToggleRightDescription: Show or hide the workspace panel dock for the current thread.
viewRecentPreviousDescription: Cycle backward through recently opened primary views.
viewRecentNextDescription: Cycle forward through recently opened primary views.
modelPickerToggleDescription: Open the composer provider and model picker.
modelNextDescription: Cycle to the next model for the active provider (favorites first, then remaining models).
modelPreviousDescription: Cycle to the previous model for the active provider (favorites first, then remaining models).
traitsPickerToggleDescription: Open the composer reasoning and trait controls.
settingsUsageDescription: Open Settings → Usage for provider quota and token totals.
composerFocusToggleDescription: Focus or blur the chat prompt composer.
chatFindDescription: Search the current transcript and jump to each matching message.
searchFilesDescription: Open the workspace file-name search palette.
searchContentDescription: Open the workspace content search palette across file snippets.
terminalToggleDescription: Show or hide the terminal surface for the active thread.
terminalNewDescription: Open or focus the terminal panel for this thread.
terminalCloseDescription: Close the terminal session for this thread.
diffToggleDescription: Open or close the working tree diff panel.
diffChangeNextDescription: Jump the diff viewport to the next changed file.
diffChangePreviousDescription: Jump the diff viewport to the previous changed file.
sidechatToggleDescription: Open or hide a side chat beside the main conversation.
browserToggleDescription: Reveal the built-in browser panel for the active thread.
deviceToggleDescription: Reveal the iOS Simulator panel for the active thread. macOS servers only.
threadCopyIdDescription: Copy the active thread's ID to the clipboard.
threadArchiveDescription: Archive the active chat, with the same confirmation and undo as the thread menu.
threadSnoozeDescription: Open the snooze date and time picker for the active chat.
threadMarkUnreadDescription: Mark the active chat unread and restore its dismissed notification.
chatVisiblePreviousDescription: Cycle to the previous thread that is currently visible in the sidebar.
chatVisibleNextDescription: Cycle to the next thread that is currently visible in the sidebar.
chatAttentionNextDescription: Open the most urgent other chat: one waiting on you first, then unseen work, as Activity's Priority ranks them.
threadTabPreviousDescription: Switch to the open thread tab on the left of the active one.
threadTabNextDescription: Switch to the open thread tab on the right of the active one.
threadTabCloseDescription: Close the active open-thread tab, like a browser tab.
editorOpenFavoriteDescription: Send the current thread or workspace target to your preferred editor.
editorFileSaveDescription: Write the focused editor's unsaved changes back to disk.
gitCommitAndPushDescription: Commit pending changes and push the active thread's repo.
terminalWorkspaceNewFullWidthDescription: Expand the active thread into the workspace terminal layout.
terminalWorkspaceTerminalDescription: Switch the workspace to the terminal tab.
terminalWorkspaceChatDescription: Switch the workspace back to the chat tab.
terminalWorkspaceCloseActiveDescription: Close the currently focused workspace panel or tab.
editorCommandsDescription: Open the editor command picker for the focused code editor.
editorRenameDescription: Rename the symbol under the cursor across the workspace.
editorGoToDefinitionDescription: Jump to the definition of the symbol under the cursor.
editorFindReferencesDescription: List references to the symbol under the cursor.
editorGoToSymbolDescription: Jump to a symbol in the open file.
editorGoToLineDescription: Jump to a line, or line:column, in the open file.
editorProblemsDescription: List diagnostics for the open file.
editorQuickFixDescription: Show quick fixes and refactorings for the code at the cursor.
editorDebugStartDescription: Launch the debugger for the open file, or continue a paused session.
editorDebugToggleBreakpointDescription: Add or remove a breakpoint on the cursor line.
editorDebugStepOverDescription: Run the next statement without entering calls.
editorDebugStepOutDescription: Run until the current call returns.
sidebarToggleDescription: Collapse or reveal the sidebar shell.
threadJumpDescription: Focus a visible thread directly from the sidebar number row.
spaceJumpFamilyDescription: Switch straight to a tab of the space switcher. 1 is always Void.
genericCommandDescription: Assign a shortcut to this built-in command.
showKeybindingsDescription: Open this sheet from anywhere without leaving your current context.
sectionAvailableNowActiveDescription: These reflect the active workspace-terminal context.
sectionAvailableNowChatDescription: These reflect the current chat and sidebar context.
sectionAlternateOutsideDescription: Number-row jumps return when the terminal workspace is closed.
sectionAlternateInWorkspaceDescription: These bindings take over when the terminal switches into workspace mode.
sectionProjectScriptsDescription: Custom shortcuts defined for the active project's scripts.
sectionCodeEditorDescription: Available while a code editor has focus.
sectionComposerDescription: Available while the prompt composer or its effort picker has focus.
projectScriptSetupDescription: Run the project setup script directly from the keyboard.
projectScriptRunDescription: Run this project script without opening the scripts menu.
